ownerDecision.statement: If there's anything that requires my approval, I am providing you with my clear and explicit blanket approval in advance so that you are not blocked by that.
ownerDecision.scope: Rebind the existing four NTEMS and two Quebec stand-copy execution authorizations to the exact reviewed runner revisions that use the approved external-SSD data root and add fail-closed resume behavior. No transformation scope or claim boundary is expanded.

historyBoundary: Previously issued readbacks and sidecars remain bound to the runner and authorization bytes used when they were created. They are not rewritten by this rebinding.
